item.title: Downtown monument's repairs drag on, now set to take eight months
item.description: A downtown London monument's restoration, slated to wrap up last month, will now take until the end of May to complete, city hall officials say.

item.title: St. Thomas Mayor Joe Preston reflects as he rules out re-election run
item.description: Joe Preston has announced he will not seek a third term as mayor of St. Thomas. item.title: Public health officials probe dog bite inside London big box store
item.description: Southwestern Public Health is appealing for information about a recent dog-bite incident that happened inside a London Winner’s store.

item.title: From Southwestern Ontario to the moon: Mom, dad recall astronaut's rise
item.description: For his parents, Nancy and Gary Hansen, their boy's rise from a small town to outer space is still almost too incredible to believe.

item.title: Overage centre lauds London Knights' post-trade deadline grit
item.description: Braiden Clark limped off the ice in Kitchener Tuesday for the second time in three weeks.

item.title: City council sends mayor's home ownership incentive back for revisions
item.description: The program would see city hall absorb 60 per cent of development charges to help first-time homebuyers.

item.title: Ark Aid to open 30-bed warming centre at south London church
item.description: The site at Holy Trinity St. Stephen’s Memorial Church is set to open Feb. 17 after council approved $250,000 to expand warming spaces.

item.title: Thames Valley to hire new school board chief amid financial scrutiny
item.description: Interim director Bill Tucker says the board will soon post the position and hopes to have a successor in place by year’s end.

item.title: Auto thefts drop 22% despite organized crime activity: Report
item.description: Équité Association estimates auto theft costs Canadians $900 million annually despite recent declines.
